instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct conjunction.

atoms.b: ((++Since Although)) our neighbours bake us something every weekend, we decided to return the favour.
The streets will be partially blocked this weekend ((++because since)) of the carnival.
They’ll let you know ((++when before)) they can lend you their lawn mower.
((++If Before)) the perpetrator was last seen in this hotel room, we should check it for fingerprints.
Sufficient wind needs to blow across the ocean surface ((++for since)) larger waves to form.
((++Although If)) she appears tough and imposing at first, she is one of the kindest people I know.
He went for a walk with his dog ((++after because)) sitting at his desk all day.
We were in the kitchen all afternoon, ((++for when)) we had to prepare for a family meal.
Emissions that cause climate change come from all over the world, ((++but since)) some countries produce much more than others.
He had just hoovered the room two days prior, ((++yet if)) enough dust and hair had accumulated that he needed to clean again.
I forgot to ask for his number or address, ((++so because)) now I don’t know how we will stay in contact.
He neither wants to become a doctor ((++nor after)) a pilot.
We could ((++either after)) listen to a podcast ((++or and)) turn on the radio.
